units.source_text: 七段回到了座位上，在额头上擦了镇痛油，用手指揉了揉。

en.t: The seventh-dan player returned to his seat, rubbed analgesic oil on his forehead, and massaged it with his fingers.

units.source_text: 身旁也放有微笑牌眼药。

en.t: A bottle of Smile-brand eye drops was also placed beside him.

units.source_text: 人们看见他这副样子，以为十二点三十分午休以前他再不下了。

en.t: Seeing him like this, people thought he would not make another move before the lunch break at twelve thirty.

units.source_text: 十二点八分，却响起了响亮的放棋子的声音。

en.t: But at twelve oh eight, the clear sound of a stone being placed rang out.
